name: Mission Vatsalya - Child Protection Services
department: Ministry of Women and Child Development
target_group: Children in need of care and protection, including girls
eligibility: Eligibility is determined under the Juvenile Justice/child protection framework and Mission Vatsalya guidelines.
benefits: Child protection, care, rehabilitation, institutional/non-institutional support and linkage to services.
documents: Documents required by Child Welfare Committee/child protection authority
application_process: Contact the Child Welfare Committee, District Child Protection Unit or designated child-protection service.
source: Ministry of Women and Child Development / Government of India
